load_and_register_attn_kernel: load and register a kernel attention implementation from the HuggingFace hub for a model
get_kernel: get a kernel module from the HuggingFace hub by repo id with optional revision and version
use_kernel_forward_from_hub: use a kernel forward method from the hub to replace a layer's forward on a model class
register_kernel_mapping_transformers: register kernel mappings for transformer layers like RMSNorm, MLP, and attention from the hub
lazy_load_kernel: lazy load a kernel module from the hub mapping by kernel name with caching
